name: Starfall Squadron
tagline: Fly ten fighters. Break ten flagships.
description: A portrait-first 3D arcade space shooter built with Three.js. Three hundred missions across ten sectors, ten flyable spacecraft with real stat differences, forty power-ups, ten capital-ship bosses with three phases each, and six extra modes. Combat runs on a fixed-step deterministic simulation with pooled projectiles, while every ship, boss and explosion is genuine 3D geometry: procedural hulls, emissive engines, animated shield bubbles and sector-specific nebulae. Your guns fire themselves, so the whole game works one-handed on a phone.
highlights: 300 missions across ten sectors, every one structurally validated in CI before it ships
Ten capital-ship bosses with three phases, destructible turrets and telegraphed attack patterns
Forty power-ups with explicit stacking rules: caps on drones, balls, buffs and weapon levels
Ten flyable ships with different hulls, shields, speed, damage and signature abilities
Deterministic 60 Hz combat simulation, pooled projectiles, and one-handed portrait controls
howToPlay: Drag anywhere in the lower part of the screen to fly. Your cannon fires automatically.
Tap the three bottom buttons for your secondary weapon, a screen bomb, and your ship's ability.
Collect glowing capsules. Green is repair, blue is shield, gold is firepower, violet is a drone or ability buff.
On flagship missions, destroy the turrets first: hull damage is heavily reduced while they are alive.
levels: 300 missions · 10 sectors + endless, boss rush, daily, arcade classic, zen and 10 challenges
